{{Top|leg}}
The '''strengthening underlay''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement that provided the wearer with a power boost. The Mark I, II, III, IV, & V versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in force and resilience of the body.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can be used with all types of armor, except for robes.
